reason: User reported battery exhaustion during serial training; no training process survived.
powerAtRecovery: AC Power; battery 60 percent and charging

interrupted.actualCompletedOptimizerUpdatesStatus: not measured; the last log is only a lower bound
interrupted.wallTimeStatus: not measured; no durable completion timestamp
interrupted.reason: No saved model, Adam, RNG, step or checkpoint-selection state exists. Partial logs are not a resumable checkpoint or an eligible result.

recoveryPolicy.staleLock: Only the verified empty models/.m8-experiment.lock may be removed with rmdir.
recoveryPolicy.sleepPrevention: Separate caffeinate -is assertion process on AC power, stopped when serial training finishes. Do not wrap the trainer command.
recoveryPolicy.preLaunchRefusal: The first recovery launch was rejected before any new start record or optimizer update: macOS caffeinate creates a child whose argv repeats the wrapped trainer command, which matches the unchanged concurrency guard. A process-tree diagnostic reproduced this wrapper behavior. Running caffeinate separately avoids that false match without relaxing the guard.
recoveryPolicy.recordChronology: Written before the restart; kept untracked until training completes to preserve the frozen execution HEAD and ownership guard. Commit with resulting execution evidence. No pre-restart Git commit is claimed.

independentReview.verdict: No P0/P1 blocker to retaining independently verified R0 and restarting only the interrupted same-seed R3 under the unchanged registered controls.
independentReview.qualification: Deterministic input streams do not by themselves assert bit-identical repeated MPS optimization. The first complete eligible restarted run is binding; there is no best-of-restarts selection.
